prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 27-year-old female veterinarian with a short dark pixie haircut puts on a plain clean work coat on her first working day. Her 43-year-old mentor with silver-streaked brown hair gently straightens the collar while they exchange a reassuring smile. Show a bright ordinary clinic staff room in soft daylight, distinct hands and realistic fabric. No animal examination, medical procedure or readable badge. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: The young veterinarian has a clearly distinct short black pixie haircut and round face; the female mentor has shoulder-length brown hair with silver streaks, oval glasses and a long narrow face. The work coat is an ordinary plain white coat with no printed badge. Mentor stands to one side and adjusts the upper collar with two clearly separate realistic hands; the younger woman holds one front edge of the coat herself. Keep faces and collar action safely framed above lower fifth. Normal continuous coats and furniture extend to bottom, no fade or synthetic band.
review: Reviewed full portrait: short-black-pixie-haired young veterinarian in a plain white coat looks toward her older female mentor with silver-streaked hair and glasses. Two distinct mentor hands straighten the collar; younger woman's own hand holds the coat front naturally. Eyes, fingers and clothing coherent; continuous photograph to bottom, no printed badge or medical procedure.
